prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished landscape game UI prototype for Tiefenhall CHALLENGES, based very closely on the supplied Upgrade panel screenshot as visual reference. Preserve dark nearly black brown wood grain, fine angular gold/brass tile corner frames, substantial outer wood/brass frame, cream serif typography, gold highlights and cave backdrop. Especially borrow its FLAT shallow trapezoid category tabs and LARGE FREESTANDING illustrated item icons (no circular medallions). Title "Herausforderungen". Tabs "Täglich", "Wöchentlich", "Langzeit", Täglich selected with warm amber fill, others dark wood. All categories represented by these tabs; daily displayed. Right header small "Neu in 08:42:16" and "1 / 6 abgeschlossen". Six challenge cards in a 3 column x 2 row grid, consistent typography. Bottom left "Zurück", no reset-points button. Card content: Erzsammler, 18 / 50 Erze, +150 XP, icon pile of ore; Tiefer graben, 42 / 100 Blöcke, +200 XP, icon pickaxe and rocks; Handwerker, 2 / 5 Gegenstände, +150 XP, icon hammer and anvil; Kupferfund, 8 / 20 Kupfer, +100 XP, icon copper ore; Händler, 350 / 1.000 $, +200 XP, icon leather coin pouch; Licht im Dunkeln, 3 / 3 Fackeln, +100 XP, icon burning torch, small gold completion check. Visually plausible progress fill percentages. Generous padding and no text overlapping frames. No UI explanations, no ranks, no upgrade costs, no buying buttons, no modern flat design. Whole panel visible. VARIANT 1: Most faithful to reference. Each spacious rectangular card has large centered icon at top, centered challenge name below, numeric progress then a segmented gold/dark metal progress bar, and simple centered gold XP reward at bottom. Finished card has full gold bar and small checkmark beside XP. Same composition/proportions as upgrade panel but adapted to challenges.
